Frame from crown to mid-thigh in every cell, complete head and shoulders with generous transparent margins, identical fixed camera, scale, body pose, head angle, lighting, and silhouette so cells can alternate in place with no jump. Prioritize crisp readable faces, exact identity, and clean alpha. High resolution landscape canvas, each cell portrait 2:3, whole atlas aspect approximately 8:9.
